summary: 43 units (130-172) reviewed word by word. The draft is careful and mostly sound: counts are as printed (210 vs 207 total correctly flagged, sites 139-145 sum to 83), typo flags are plausible, conjectures are hedged in both languages and low confidence is on the right units (150, 155). One real error: unit 151 'hanū ubhayato' is regular (ubhayataḥ takes the accusative), so the text_flag, the note, the gram 'nom. du.' and the translations 'at the jaws' are wrong; patched. Minor: sakthi='limb' is an inference and is now hedged ('probably') in 133 and 160; Hindi tidy-ups in 137 (no 'ribs' addition), 148 (bhaga gloss, garbled sāmudga phrase); gender labels on pronouns for unstated nouns in 130, 134, 155, 157. Normalisations barttāḥ/mūrddha/kūrcca are covered by the glossary and need no flag. No identification found wrong (kaṇṭhanāḍī windpipe, akṣaka collarbone, aṃsapīṭha shoulder-blade region all properly hedged or standard). Human decisions: u141 (nibaddhā may be a split compound member needing no emendation), u155 parse, u172 gender of akṣaka. No regrouping suggested; the GROUPING notes (130-132, 133-134, 156-159, 160-161) are sensible.
